topography.project_purpose: Overtime is an on-chain sportsbook, prediction-market, and digital-options ecosystem that enables users to trade sports event outcomes, participate in speed markets, and engage with casino-style games. It provides liquidity pools, automated market makers, and staking mechanisms across multiple chains.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Overtime family shares infrastructure through proxy-based upgradeability and factory-deployed tokens. SpeedMarketsAMM and ChainedSpeedMarketsAMM rely on shared liquidity pools and governance managers, while StakingThales integrates with the ecosystem's token incentives.
